runtimeMapLoadingSignoffLabel: Runtime Map Loading Signoff Checklist Ready
productionDecision: No source code was changed. Patch 20 creates the browser/network signoff checklist needed before changing Capital or Exchange route imports.

signoffRoutes.passCondition: Mapbox and MapLibre chunks should not appear in Network before a map route is opened.
Hub dashboard should load without pulling Mapbox or MapLibre chunks unless a map view is opened.
Capital entry should not preload Mapbox unless the Exchange/Unified Truth map route is immediately rendered.
signoffRoutes.knownRisk: Patch 19 detected Mapbox preload references in dist/capital.html.

signoffRoutes.passCondition: Mapbox should load only when the Unified Truth/operational map surface is actually mounted.
Mapbox can load here because this is the Mapbox-powered Unified Truth/operational map path.
MapLibre can load only when MapHero/OperationalMap surfaces are rendered.

browserSteps: Record whether vendor-mapbox and vendor-maplibre load immediately.
Navigate to the map route and confirm the correct map engine loads only then.
Take note of any route where map chunks load before map UI appears.
signoffPassRules: Non-map routes should not load vendor-mapbox or vendor-maplibre immediately.
Capital entry should not preload vendor-mapbox unless the visible first route actually needs the Exchange/Unified Truth map.
Unified Truth map route may load vendor-mapbox.
MapLibre visual routes may load vendor-maplibre.
Mapbox route should not require MapLibre unless both map systems are visible.
MapLibre route should not require Mapbox unless both map systems are visible.
signoffFailRules: vendor-mapbox loads on a non-map route before any map UI appears.
vendor-maplibre loads on a non-map route before any map UI appears.
capital.html always preloads vendor-mapbox even when the first visible route is not a map.
Both map engines load for a route that only displays one map system.
recommendedDecision: Run browser signoff. If capital.html loads vendor-mapbox before the map appears, Patch 21 should audit the Capital/Exchange preload chain.

nextPatchRecommendation.label: Capital Exchange Preload Chain Audit
nextPatchRecommendation.goal: Audit capital.html / capital entry route imports to find why vendor-mapbox is preloaded before the actual map route.
